generate_group_by_data: generate group-by benchmark data with specified rows, groups, null ratio, and sort option
generate_group_by_data_random: generate random group-by benchmark data with 10 million rows and 100 groups without nulls
generate_group_by_data_sorted: generate sorted group-by benchmark data with 100 million rows, 10 groups, and 5 percent nulls
write_data_csv: write generated group-by benchmark data to a CSV file with auto-generated filename
run_datagen_cli: run the datagen_groupby CLI to generate benchmark data with specified rows, groups, null percentage, and sort flag
